text: Scott: P1, needs you: main is RED since 1eeb492 (PR #29) — 'chatcode -c dev say hi' silently posts to #general again; tests/test_channel_flag_position.py fails on main. Please review #51 and merge, or hand it to a second pair of eyes — main should not stay red while we review each other.

Land it exactly as ruled: default-OFF flag, non-replication leads the report, no official-chain claim.
